quote.text: Brett moved us off Wix and had our new website up fast. He fixed our Google Business Profile, built a quote form where customers send their measurements and photos, and gave us an easy way to ask for reviews. He answers quickly, knows what he's doing, and made the whole thing easy. I'd recommend him to any business owner.

about.heading: Who you'd be working with.
about.body:
I spent ten years running operations before I wrote software. A service lane at a Honda dealership. General manager of a car wash, then a group of them, then a district. Schedules, payroll, and equipment that breaks on the coldest day of the year.

Now I'm the lead engineer on a company-wide platform for a construction company, built end to end. This is the same work, for businesses of any size closer to home.

There's no company here. Just me. Nobody in the middle needs you to keep renting, so what I build is yours, and when it needs changing you call the person who built it.
